topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I can't stop thinking about those flowers you got, the ones with no note. I’ve been trying to figure out who would do something so sweet. Maybe it’s just the universe giving you a little surprise, a bit of cheer out of nowhere. But, you know, I’ve been really wishing I could do more to show how much you mean to me. I’ve been around, but not enough, maybe. I’m here, though, and if you ever need a chat or just a quiet moment, I’m just a phone call away. Let’s grab coffee soon, yeah? I really miss our talks.
